body:
Acknowledging the wake on NUL-18.

Status: plan written, request for approval pending.

- Plan doc uploaded as the `plan` document on this issue (revision `dfd01b96-f6d1-45a8-8eec-dc85913bbf18`).
- `request_confirmation` interaction `464b4f36-cbba-438d-a868-822ab640ac1c` is open, awaiting Founding Engineer review.
- Marking this issue `blocked` until that interaction is accepted or revised. Unblock owner: Founding Engineer (`a240de18-bdbe-4c2d-9fb6-e292e6649b47`). Unblock action: accept or reject the plan.

Headline decisions the plan asks the Founding Engineer to weigh in on:

1. Cookie-based session for v1 (proposed); defer bearer token to a follow-up child issue once the Mobile Engineer is hired. Web adapter can use cookies today; mobile client shape isn't not known yet.
2. Default seed password `ipam-dev`, printed in dev-server startup logs with a warning. Alternative: require an explicit env var to enable dev login.

Other items surfaced explicitly as out-of-scope for NUL-18:

- Frontend adapter (`src/lib/api/adapter.ts`) wiring to call `/api/auth/login` and use the cookie; flagged as the next child issue after this PR lands.
- Replacing the hard-coded `src/store/tenant-store.ts` defaults with a real `/api/auth/me` consumer; same follow-up.
- Drizzle-versioned migrations (NUL-20). The auth additions land as a single idempotent ALTER in the existing bootstrap, which NUL-20 will replace.
- Audit log + conflict detection (NUL-12) -- explicitly sequenced after NUL-18 per the charter.
